Openly licensed structures made for the tests from CoRE MOF 2024's SI
subset (CC-BY-4.0; G. Zhao, L. Brabson, S. Chheda, J. Huang, H. Kim,
K. Liu et al., CoRE MOF DB: a curated experimental metal-organic
framework database with machine-learned properties for integrated
material-process screening, Matter 8, 102140 (2025)). Each file says
what was changed.

  zn_dia_uncharged.cif  2020[Zn][dia]3[ASR]1 (doi:10.1039/C9CC06849J) with
                        its PACMAN charge column removed: an uncharged
                        framework for the RASPA2-export tests (round 75).
